mentions.name: Solace
mentions.description: A programming language that compiles to JavaScript, providing syntactic improvements and type-checking, with a signal-based system called live variables that unifies promises, async/await, and callbacks. Live variables can be compiled through interchangeable compiler plugins into framework-specific code, such as React's useState or Vue's Refs, to make code more future-proof. The project is currently in a concept stage.
mentions.problem: JavaScript code involving promises, async/await, and callbacks is complex; the language aims to streamline these into one signal-based system.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started playing around with the idea of a new programming language that compiles to JavaScript. Despite syntactic improvements and type-checking, it's goal is to streamline promises, async/await and callbacks into one signal based system I call live variables.
